AUTOSAR Классическая безопасность & Обнаружение вторжений

Кластер безопасности защищает функции подключенного автомобиля от киберугроз посредством обнаружения вторжений (IdsM), криптографической PDU аутентификации и защиты актуальности (SecOC), а также управления ключами и сертификатами (KeyM).

Systemarchitektur & Rolle des Modulclusters

Das Modulcluster Security & Intrusion Detection der AUTOSAR Classic Platform (Release R20-11) stellt die Basissicherheitsdienste für Steuergeräte bereit. Es setzt sich aus sechs zentralen Basissoftware-Modulen (BSW) zusammen: SecOC (Secure Onboard Communication), IdsM (Intrusion Detection System Manager), KeyM (Key Manager), Csm (Crypto Service Manager), CryIf (Crypto Interface) und Crypto (Crypto Driver). Gemeinsam gewährleisten diese Module den Schutz vor Manipulation und Ausspähung der fahrzeuginternen PDU-Kommunikation, die Erkennung und Filterung von Angriffsmustern sowie das sichere Schlüsselmanagement und die Abstraktion kryptografischer Hardwarebeschleuniger oder Software-Krypto-Bibliotheken [SWS_SecOC_00040], [SWS_IdsM_01202], [SWS_KeyM_00021], [SWS_Csm_00940], [SWS_CryIf_91003], [SWS_Crypto_91003].

In der AUTOSAR-Schichtenarchitektur sind die Aufgaben klar aufgeteilt: SecOC fungiert als Kommunikationserweiterung unmittelbar auf PDU-Ebene neben dem PDU-Router (PduR) und sichert die Authentizität und Aktualität von I-PDUs über Message Authentication Codes (MAC) und Frischewerte ab [SWS_SecOC_00103], [SWS_SecOC_00138]. IdsM sammelt Sicherheitsereignisse (Security Events, SEvs) von BSW-Modulen und Applikations-SW-Cs, qualifiziert diese über strukturierte Filterketten zu QSEvs und übergibt sie an konfigurierte Senken wie PduR oder Dem [SWS_IdsM_00101], [SWS_IdsM_00902], [SWS_IdsM_01203]. KeyM verwaltet kryptografische Schlüssel und Zertifikatsketten (z. B. X.509) und steuert deren Aktualisierung und Verifikation [SWS_KeyM_00037], [SWS_KeyM_00059]. Der kryptografische Unterbau wird über den dreistufigen Krypto-Stack gebildet: Csm bietet standardisierte kryptografische Primitiven und Job-Warteschlangen für die BSW und Applikationsebene an [SWS_Csm_00940], [SWS_Csm_01011]; CryIf routet diese kanalisiert und treiberneutral an die jeweils zuständigen Treiberinstanzen weiter [SWS_CryIf_00143]; Crypto steuert schließlich Hardware-Security-Module (HSM) oder hardwarenahe Softwaretreiber partitioniert an [SWS_Crypto_CONSTR_00001], [SWS_Crypto_CONSTR_00003].

Kontextdiagramm: Architektur und Modulbeziehungen des Clusters Security & Intrusion Detection. Quellen: [SWS_SecOC_00040], [SWS_IdsM_00101], [SWS_IdsM_01202], [SWS_KeyM_00037], [SWS_Csm_00940], [SWS_CryIf_91003], [SWS_Crypto_91003].

Zusammenspiel & Interaktionspfade zwischen den Modulen

Das Modulcluster weist klar definierte vertikale und horizontale Daten- und Aufrufketten auf. In Senderichtung einer gesicherten Nachricht initiiert der PDU-Router über SecOC_IfTransmit oder SecOC_TpTransmit die Übertragung einer authentischen I-PDU [SWS_SecOC_00112], [SWS_SecOC_91008]. SecOC bezieht den aktuellen Frischewert über die konfigurierte Frische-Schnittstelle (entweder als C-Funktion via SecOC_GetTxFreshness / SecOC_GetTxFreshnessTruncData oder über RTE-Ports) [SWS_SecOC_00230], [SWS_SecOC_91003], [SWS_SecOC_91004]. Anschließend fordert SecOC über Csm_MacGenerate die Erstellung des MAC an [SWS_SecOC_00138], [SWS_Csm_00982]. CryIf transformiert und routet diesen Auftrag via CryIf_ProcessJob an den Crypto Driver (Crypto_ProcessJob) [SWS_CryIf_91003], [SWS_Crypto_91003]. Sobald der MAC vorliegt, fügt SecOC die Secured I-PDU zusammen (oder sendet die authentische I-PDU und kryptografische I-PDU im Sammlungsmodus getrennt innerhalb desselben Zyklus) und übergibt sie an die Transportschicht [SWS_SecOC_00063], [SWS_SecOC_00201], [SWS_SecOC_00202], [SWS_SecOC_00209].

In Empfangsrichtung empfängt SecOC die PDU über SecOC_RxIndication bzw. SecOC_StartOfReception / SecOC_CopyRxData und speichert diese vollständig im internen Puffer [SWS_SecOC_00124], [SWS_SecOC_00128], [SWS_SecOC_00255]. Die Verifikation erfolgt in sequenziellen Schritten: Extrahieren von Nutzdaten, Authenticator und gegebenenfalls gekürztem Frischewert, Rekonstruktion des vollständigen Frischewerts über SecOC_GetRxFreshness bzw. SecOC_GetRxFreshnessAuthData und Aufruf von Csm_MacVerify [SWS_SecOC_00040], [SWS_SecOC_00244], [SWS_SecOC_00250], [SWS_Csm_01050]. Schlägt die Verifikation fehl, wird dies über den Verifikationsstatus propagiert und führt bei aktivierter Sicherheitsberichterstattung direkt zu einem Security Event (SECOC_SEV_MAC_VERIFICATION_FAILURE) an den IdsM [SWS_SecOC_00149], [SWS_SecOC_00273], [SWS_SecOC_00274], [SWS_SecOC_00275].

Der IdsM nimmt solche Ereignisse über seine Services IdsM_SetSecurityEvent, IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithContextData oder Smart-Sensor-Schnittstellen mit Zählern und Zeitstempeln entgegen [SWS_IdsM_00300], [SWS_IdsM_00301], [SWS_IdsM_00401], [SWS_IdsM_00403]. Eingehende SEvs werden in Ereignispuffern und zugeordneten Kontextdatenpuffern zwischengespeichert [SWS_IdsM_00702], [SWS_IdsM_00705], [SWS_IdsM_00706]. In den Filterketten wird das Ereignis gefiltert und als QSEv aufbereitet [SWS_IdsM_00902]. Sofern konfiguriert, fordert der IdsM vor der Weiterleitung eine kryptografische Signatur des QSEv beim CSM an (Csm_SignatureGenerate) [SWS_IdsM_01204], [SWS_IdsM_01206], [SWS_Csm_00992]. Anschließend wird die Nachricht über den PduR versendet (als IF-PDU oder über TP-Segmentierung) oder zur Persistierung an Dem/Sem übergeben [SWS_IdsM_01202], [SWS_IdsM_01400], [SWS_IdsM_01401], [SWS_IdsM_01600].

Im Pfad des Schlüssel- und Zertifikatsmanagements wickelt KeyM Operationen wie Schlüsselaustausch, Zertifikatsprüfung und Schlüsselaktualisierung ab [SWS_KeyM_00050], [SWS_KeyM_00052], [SWS_KeyM_00059]. Interpretation: KeyM dürfte für kryptografische Operationen primär die Schnittstellen des CSM nutzen, da AUTOSAR eine strikte Schichtung vorsieht und KeyM keine direkten Hardwarezugriffe implementiert [SWS_KeyM_00037], [SWS_KeyM_00076], [SWS_KeyM_00078]. Über den CSM-Stack (Csm_KeyDerive, Csm_KeyElementSet, CryIf_KeyDerive, Crypto_KeyDerive) werden die abgeleiteten oder aktualisierten Schlüsselobjekte im Crypto Driver eingerichtet und validiert [SWS_Csm_00956], [SWS_Csm_00957], [SWS_Csm_01018], [SWS_CryIf_91009], [SWS_Crypto_91008], [SWS_Crypto_91014]. Manipulationsversuche an Root-Zertifikaten meldet KeyM seinerseits als Security Events an den IdsM [SWS_KeyM_00172].

Sequenzdiagramm: Verifikationsablauf einer gesicherten PDU über SecOC, Freshness Manager, CSM, CryIf und Crypto Driver mit Meldung an IdsM. Quellen: [SWS_SecOC_00040], [SWS_SecOC_00124], [SWS_SecOC_00237], [SWS_SecOC_00273], [SWS_Csm_01050], [SWS_CryIf_91003], [SWS_Crypto_91003], [SWS_IdsM_00301].

Synchronisation, Reentranz und Task-Kontexte

Kryptografische Berechnungen und Intrusion-Detection-Analysen sind rechenintensiv und erfordern ein durchdachtes Task- und Synchronisationskonzept. Die BSW-Module des Clusters trennen daher zeitkritische Aufrufe von der asynchronen Hintergrundverarbeitung über dedizierte MainFunctions:

  • SecOC_MainFunctionRx und SecOC_MainFunctionTx: Verarbeiten PDU-Warteschlangen, überwachen Wiederholungsversuche bei belegtem CSM (E_BUSY) und stellen bei Sammlungen (Collections) die synchrone Bereitstellung innerhalb desselben Zyklus sicher [SWS_SecOC_00171], [SWS_SecOC_00176], [SWS_SecOC_00202], [SWS_SecOC_00237], [SWS_SecOC_00276].
  • IdsM_MainFunction: Arbeitet die gepufferten Security Events asynchron ab, berechnet Aggregations- und Schwellwert-Zeitintervalle und wickelt Raten- sowie Traffic-Begrenzungen ab [SWS_IdsM_00702], [SWS_IdsM_00901], [SWS_IdsM_01050], [SWS_IdsM_01064], [SWS_IdsM_01082], [SWS_IdsM_91000].
  • KeyM_MainFunction und KeyM_MainBackgroundFunction: Steuern mehrstufige Zertifikatsprüfungen und asynchrone Schlüsseloperationen ohne Blockierung hochpriorer Tasks [SWS_KeyM_00074], [SWS_KeyM_00075], [SWS_KeyM_00149].
  • Csm_MainFunction und Crypto_MainFunction: Verwalten priorisierte Job-Warteschlangen (CsmQueues) und koordinieren asynchrone Jobs über Callbacks (Csm_CallbackNotification, CryIf_CallbackNotification) [SWS_Csm_00479], [SWS_Csm_00940], [SWS_Csm_00944], [SWS_Csm_00970], [SWS_CryIf_91013], [SWS_Crypto_91012].

Hinsichtlich der Reentranz sind die Meldungsschnittstellen des IdsM (IdsM_SetSecurityEvent*) so spezifiziert, dass sie reentrant aus beliebigen Task- und ISR-Kontexten aufgerufen werden können; die Ereignisse werden unmittelbar in dedizierte Puffer kopiert, um die Latenz im aufrufenden Kontext minimal zu halten [SWS_IdsM_00702], [SWS_IdsM_91002], [SWS_IdsM_91003]. Im Crypto Driver arbeitet jede Instanz als unabhängige Einheit in ihrer jeweiligen Partition, wodurch Aufrufe isoliert werden und partitionsübergreifende Blockaden vermieden werden [SWS_Crypto_CONSTR_00001], [SWS_Crypto_CONSTR_00002]. SecOC isoliert über getrennte Pufferstrukturen für Authentic-, Cryptographic- und Secured-PDUs konkurrierende Sende- und Empfangsvorgänge [SWS_SecOC_00204], [SWS_SecOC_CONSTR_00265].

Typische Lebenszyklen und Betriebsmodi

Die Initialisierung des Clusters folgt einer strikten hierarchischen Reihenfolge vom hardwarenahen Treiber zur Service- und Kommunikationsebene:

  1. Crypto_Init initialisiert den Krypto-Treiber (der Konfigurationszeiger muss gemäß Spezifikation NULL_PTR sein) [SWS_Crypto_00215], [SWS_Crypto_91000].
  2. CryIf_Init baut die Zuordnungstabellen der Kanäle zu den Treiberobjekten auf [SWS_CryIf_91000].
  3. Csm_Init versetzt den Crypto Service Manager in den initialisierten Zustand und schaltet die Primitiven-Warteschlangen frei [SWS_Csm_00646], [SWS_Csm_01028].
  4. Interpretation: Die Initialisierung des Moduls KeyM dürfte vermutlich erst nach CSM und CryIf erfolgen, da KeyM für kryptografische Zertifikatsprüfungen auf betriebsbereite CSM-Primitive angewiesen ist; KeyM_Init setzt die internen Zustände auf Basis des übergebenen Konfigurationszeigers (welcher NULL_PTR sein muss) [SWS_KeyM_00043], [SWS_KeyM_00158].
  5. IdsM_Init initialisiert alle internen Variablen, stellt Puffer bereit und liest persistierte Berichtsmodi aus dem NvM-RAM-Block [SWS_IdsM_00202], [SWS_IdsM_01705], [SWS_IdsM_01706], [SWS_IdsM_91001].
  6. SecOC_Init versetzt SecOC in den Zustand SECOC_INIT, womit PDU-Sende- und Empfangsdienste aktiviert werden [SWS_SecOC_00106], [SWS_SecOC_00162].

Im laufenden Betrieb reagieren die Module dynamisch auf System- und Moduswechsel. Das Basissoftware-Modemanagement (BswM) informiert den IdsM über Zustandsänderungen via IdsM_BswM_StateChanged; der Block-State-Filter des IdsM unterdrückt daraufhin konfigurierte Sicherheitsereignisse in definierten Zuständen (z. B. beim Flashen oder Hochlauf) [SWS_IdsM_01021], [SWS_IdsM_01022], [SWS_IdsM_91005]. Diagnoseseitig erlaubt der Dcm das Auslesen und Umschalten des Berichtsmodus von Ereignissen zur Laufzeit über IdsM_Dcm_SetReportingMode_Start und IdsM_Dcm_GetReportingMode_Start, wobei geänderte Modi im NvM gesichert werden [SWS_IdsM_01700], [SWS_IdsM_01701], [SWS_IdsM_01900], [SWS_IdsM_01901], [SWS_IdsM_02000], [SWS_IdsM_02001]. In SecOC ermöglicht SecOC_VerifyStatusOverride das temporäre Deaktivieren oder Übersteuern der MAC-Verifikation (Status SECOC_OVERRIDE_DROP_UNTIL_NOTICE), was etwa in Werkstatt- oder Bandablauf-Modi erforderlich ist [SWS_SecOC_00122], [SWS_SecOC_00991]. KeyM unterscheidet für Schlüsselaktualisierungen explizit zwischen OEM-Produktionsmodus (KEYM_START_OEM_PRODUCTIONMODE) und Werkstattmodus (KEYM_START_WORKSHOPMODE) [SWS_KeyM_00038], [SWS_KeyM_00050]. Die Deinitialisierung erfolgt über SecOC_DeInit und KeyM_Deinit [SWS_SecOC_00161], [SWS_KeyM_00047].

Fehlerbehandlung, Det-Tracing und Degradation

Die Robustheit des Clusters basiert auf einer klaren Differenzierung zwischen Entwicklungsfehlern (Det), Laufzeitfehlern und Angriffsszenarien. Bei aktiviertem IdsMDevErrorDetect, KeyMDevErrorDetect bzw. Treiber-Det prüfen alle Module API-Aufrufe vorab auf Gültigkeit:

  • Uninitialisierter Modulaufruf meldet SECOC_E_UNINIT, IDSM_E_PARAM_UNINIT, KEYM_E_UNINIT, CRYIF_E_UNINIT bzw. CRYPTO_E_UNINIT an das Default Error Tracing (Det) [SWS_SecOC_00101], [SWS_IdsM_00203], [SWS_KeyM_00144], [SWS_CryIf_00009], [SWS_Crypto_00040].
  • Null-Zeiger werden einheitlich über Fehlercodes wie SECOC_E_PARAM_POINTER, IDSM_E_PARAM_POINTER, KEYM_E_PARAM_POINTER oder CSM_E_PARAM_POINTER erfasst [SWS_SecOC_00101], [SWS_IdsM_02003], [SWS_KeyM_00036], [SWS_KeyM_00146], [SWS_Csm_91004].
  • Ungültige Puffergrößen, Schlüssel-IDs oder Event-IDs führen zum sofortigen Abbruch der Operation und Det-Meldung (z. B. KEYM_E_SMALL_BUFFER oder IDSM_E_PARAM_INVALID) [SWS_KeyM_00036], [SWS_KeyM_00145], [SWS_IdsM_02003], [SWS_Crypto_00180], [SWS_Crypto_00195].

Laufzeitfehler und temporäre Überlastungen werden durch spezifische Degradations- und Wiederholungsmechanismen abgefangen. Meldet der CSM während der MAC-Berechnung oder -Verifikation einen behebbaren Fehler wie CRYPTO_E_BUSY oder CSM_E_QUEUE_FULL, verwirft SecOC die PDU nicht sofort, sondern inkrementiert den internen authentication build counter und wiederholt den Versuch im Folgezyklus, bis der Grenzwert SecOCAuthenticationBuildAttempts erreicht ist [SWS_SecOC_00151], [SWS_SecOC_00234], [SWS_SecOC_00236], [SWS_SecOC_00237], [SWS_SecOC_00238], [SWS_Csm_01089]. Erst bei Erreichen des Grenzwerts wird die Authentic I-PDU aus dem Puffer entfernt und verworfen [SWS_SecOC_00240]. Schlägt die Abfrage des Frischewerts fehl (Rückgabewert E_NOT_OK), wird die Verifikation sofort abgebrochen (SECOC_E_FRESHNESS_FAILURE) und die PDU verworfen [SWS_SecOC_00114], [SWS_SecOC_00229], [SWS_SecOC_00248], [SWS_SecOC_00256].

Im IdsM führen Ressourcenengpässe zur Auslösung interner Sicherheitsereignisse: Steht bei einem eingehenden Event kein freier Ereignispuffer zur Verfügung, wird das interne Ereignis IDSM_INTERNAL_EVENT_NO_EVENT_BUFFER_AVAILABLE ausgelöst [SWS_IdsM_00703], [SWS_IdsM_91015]. Fehlt ein passender Kontextdatenpuffer, wird das Ereignis ohne Kontextdaten weiterverarbeitet und optional No Context Data Buffer Available gemeldet [SWS_IdsM_00707], [SWS_IdsM_00708]. Schlägt beim Dcm-gesteuerten Ändern des Berichtsmodus die Persistierung im NvM fehl, führt der IdsM einen Rollback auf den vorherigen Zustand durch und antwortet mit DCM_E_GENERALPROGRAMMINGFAILURE [SWS_IdsM_01702], [SWS_IdsM_01904], [SWS_IdsM_01905]. Im Zufallszahlengenerator des Krypto-Stacks führt mangelnde Entropie zur Rückgabe von CRYPTO_E_ENTROPY_EXHAUSTED bzw. CRYPTO_E_RE_ENTROPY_EXHAUSTED, womit unsichere Zufallswerte verhindert werden [SWS_Crypto_00141], [SWS_Crypto_00194], [SWS_Csm_91043].

Dieser Leitfaden basiert auf den Spezifikationen der AUTOSAR Classic Platform Release R20-11.

Модули в кластере

Менеджер системы обнаружения вторжений (IdsM)

Собирает и сообщает о событиях безопасности на борту для обнаружения угроз.

BSW ID 252 21 API (16 функций, 5 типов) #include "IdsM.h"

Безопасная бортовая связь (SecOC)

Обеспечивает криптографическую аутентификацию и защиту актуальности для критически важных PDU связи.

BSW ID 150 33 API (27 функций, 6 типов) #include "SecOC.h"

Ключевой менеджер (KeyM)

Управляет жизненным циклом, хранением и распространением криптографических ключей и сертификатов.

BSW ID 113 42 API (27 функций, 15 типов) #include "KeyM.h"

Du bist der offizielle KI-Kurations-Assistent für das autodocs Dokumentations- und Spezifikationssystem (AUTOSAR & S-Core).
Deine Aufgabe ist es, präzise, fachlich fundierte Erklärungen, User Guides und Diagramme zu verfassen.

FOLGENDE RICHTLINIEN SIND STRIKT BINDEND:
# Richtlinien für KI-generierte Erklärungen

Diese Datei wird von den Prompt-Rezepten (`_src/tools/prompt_recipes.py`)
wörtlich in jeden Prompt eingebettet. Jede Änderung ändert daher alle
Prompt-Hashes; bestehende KI-Texte gelten dann als veraltet und werden neu
erzeugt. Herkunft und Ablage der Ausgaben regelt `_src/lib_ai_store.py`.

## Sprache

- Kanonische Sprache ist Deutsch. Die Übersetzung ist ein nachgelagerter Schritt
  und nie Teil der Generierung.
- API-Bezeichner, Typnamen, Enum-Werte, Code und Kennungen wie `[SWS_…]` bleiben
  unverändert.

## Struktur

- Jedes Fragment ist genau ein `<div class="ai …">` (Varianten: `ai usage` für
  Verwendungshinweise an einem Spezifikationselement, `ai module-guide` für
  Modul-Leitfäden) und endet mit genau einem `<p class="ai-note">` (KI-Hinweis).
- Erlaubte Elemente im Fragment: `div`, `p`, `h4`, `ul`, `ol`, `li`, `code`,
  `strong`, `em`, `a`, `span`, `table`, `thead`, `tbody`, `tr`, `th`, `td`.
  Keine Skripte, keine Stile, keine Bilder, kein `<svg>` (Diagramme siehe unten).
- Alle Tags korrekt geschlossen und verschachtelt.

## Belegpflicht

- Jede fachliche Aussage ist zu belegen. Belege stammen ausschließlich aus dem
  Payload des Prompts; nichts darf aus anderem Wissen als Beleg ausgegeben werden.
- Verweis auf ein Spezifikationselement oder Requirement (nur IDs, die im
  Payload vorkommen):
  `<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_…">[SWS_…]</a>` — ohne `href`; den
  Link setzt der Generator.
- Verweis auf eine Dokumentstelle (nur Dokument/Seite aus dem Payload):
  `<span class="docref" data-doc="<Dokument-ID>" data-page="<Seite>">Kurzname §x.y „Titel“</span>`.
- Niemals URLs ausgeben, insbesondere keine PDF-URLs.

## Annahmen (Wissenslücken)

- Wo die Quellen schweigen, sind höchstens 3 Annahmen je Text und 2 je
  Diagramm erlaubt.
- Jede Annahme ist im Text als Interpretation erkennbar („dürfte“, „vermutlich“,
  „Interpretation:“) und wird am Ende des Fragments in einem Kommentar
  `<!-- annahmen: 1) … – Begründung: … -->` aufgezählt.
- Reicht das Budget nicht, wird der Aspekt weggelassen — niemals unmarkiert
  spekulieren.

## Diagramme

Ein Diagramm nur, wenn es gegenüber dem Text Mehrwert bietet:

- Sequenzdiagramm: Abläufe ab 3 Schritten oder mit nicht offensichtlicher
  Reihenfolge/Asynchronität.
- Kontext-/Kollaborationsdiagramm: ab 3 beteiligten Komponenten.
- Zustandsdiagramm: Lebenszyklen und Zustandsmaschinen.
- Aktivitätsdiagramm: Entscheidungs- oder Verarbeitungsabläufe mit Verzweigung.
- Keine Trivialdiagramme (einzelne Aufrufe, Getter/Setter, Zweierbeziehungen).

Beschriftungen deutsch, Bezeichner unverändert. Jedes Diagramm steht im
Fragment als Platzhalter `<div class="diagram" id="diag-<kurzname>"></div>`,
direkt gefolgt von `<p class="diagram-note"><Diagrammart>: <Kernaussage>.
Quellen: <Belege></p>`. Die Diagrammquelle wird separat ausgegeben (Format
legt der Prompt fest).

KONTEXT-SYNTHESE- & EVIDENZ-REGELN (CONCEPT-0056):
1. KONTINUIERLICHE SYNTHESE: Alle übergebenen Inbound-Snippets fließen ohne Kurationspause ein.
2. ZWEISTUFIGE EVIDENZ-KENNZEICHNUNG:
   - VERIFIED (Score >= 0.95): Normativ verbindliche Belege, faktischer Text, Badge <span class="badge-pill bp-curated">🔒 Verifizierter Kontext</span>.
   - UNVERIFIED (0.70 <= Score < 0.95): Zwingend mit folgender Warnbox formatieren:
     <div class="ai-unverified-evidence" data-snippet-id="{ID}" data-confidence="{SCORE}">
       <div class="ai-unverified-header">
         <span class="badge-pill bp-ai">⚠️ UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS &bull; Konfidenz: {SCORE}</span>
         <span class="ai-unverified-actions">
           <a href="spec/record.html?id={REC_ID}#curate-{ID}" class="btn-curate-inline dossier-open-link" data-dossier-target="dossier-modal-{REC_ID}" data-snippet-id="{ID}">🔍 Im Curation-Editor prüfen &rarr;</a>
         </span>
       </div>
       <p class="ai-unverified-body">
         <strong>UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS (Nicht ohne formale Kuration für Serienentwicklung verwenden):</strong><br>
         <em>Interpretation / Vorläufiger Kontext:</em> [Interpretation der Anforderung]
       </p>
     </div>

void Csm_MainFunction (void);

API, который будет вызываться циклически для обработки запрошенных заданий. Основная функция Csm_ должна проверять очереди на наличие заданий для передачи базовому CRYIF. Konstituierend · function
void SecOC_Init (const SecOC_ConfigType* config);

Инициализирует модуль Sec OC. Успешная инициализация приводит к состоянию Sec OC_ INIT. В конфигурациях, в которых Sec OC назначен более чем одному разделу (т. е. Sec OC_ Main Functions сопоставлен с разделами), Sec OC может предоставить один init AUTOSAR CP R20 - документа ID : AUTOSAR_SWS_SecureOnboardCommunication функция для каждого раздела. Решение о том, предоставляется ли одна функция Sec OC_ Init() или одна для каждого раздела, зависит от реализации. В случае, если данная реализация предоставляет одну функцию Sec OC_ Init() для каждого раздела, реализация должна разработать шаблон именования, который предотвращает конфликты имен между различными функциями Sec OC_ Init() (например, путем добавления суффикса, содержащего короткое имя Ecuc Partition.

В пределах этого API модуль верхнего уровня (называемый модулем) должен проверить, помещаются ли доступные данные в размер буфера, сообщаемый Pdu Info Ptr - >Sdu Длина. Если он подходит, он должен скопировать свои данные в буфер, предоставленный Pdu Info Ptr - >Sdu Data Ptr, и обновить длину фактически скопированных данных в Pdu Info Ptr - >Sdu Длина. Если нет, он возвращает E_ NOT_ OK без изменения Pdu Info Ptr.

Konstituierend · function
BufReq_ReturnType IdsM_CopyTxData (PduIdType id, const PduInfoType* info, const RetryInfoType* retry, PduLengthType* availableDataPtr);

Эта функция вызывается для получения передаваемых данных сегмента I-PDU (N-PDU). Каждый вызов этой функции предоставляет следующую часть данных I-PDU, если только retry->TpDataState не равен TP_ DATARETRY. В этом случае функция перезапускается для копирования данных, начиная со смещения от текущей позиции, указанной retry->TxTpDataCnt. Размер оставшихся данных записывается в позицию, указанную в AvailableDataPtr.

Эта функция используется для подготовки операции обновления ключа. Основная цель — предоставить информацию для ключевой операции на сервер ключей. === SYSTEM PROMPT ===
Du bist der KI-Kurations-Assistent des Dokumentationssystems autodocs (AUTOSAR).
Verfasse den Cluster-Leitfaden (<div class="ai cluster-guide">) für das Modulcluster 'Security & Intrusion Detection' (Module: secoc, idsm, keym, crypto, csm, cryif) der Classic Platform im Release R20-11.

RICHTLINIEN (bindend):
# Richtlinien für KI-generierte Erklärungen

Diese Datei wird von den Prompt-Rezepten (`_src/tools/prompt_recipes.py`)
wörtlich in jeden Prompt eingebettet. Jede Änderung ändert daher alle
Prompt-Hashes; bestehende KI-Texte gelten dann als veraltet und werden neu
erzeugt. Herkunft und Ablage der Ausgaben regelt `_src/lib_ai_store.py`.

## Sprache

- Kanonische Sprache ist Deutsch. Die Übersetzung ist ein nachgelagerter Schritt
  und nie Teil der Generierung.
- API-Bezeichner, Typnamen, Enum-Werte, Code und Kennungen wie `[SWS_…]` bleiben
  unverändert.

## Struktur

- Jedes Fragment ist genau ein `<div class="ai …">` (Varianten: `ai usage` für
  Verwendungshinweise an einem Spezifikationselement, `ai module-guide` für
  Modul-Leitfäden) und endet mit genau einem `<p class="ai-note">` (KI-Hinweis).
- Erlaubte Elemente im Fragment: `div`, `p`, `h4`, `ul`, `ol`, `li`, `code`,
  `strong`, `em`, `a`, `span`, `table`, `thead`, `tbody`, `tr`, `th`, `td`.
  Keine Skripte, keine Stile, keine Bilder, kein `<svg>` (Diagramme siehe unten).
- Alle Tags korrekt geschlossen und verschachtelt.

## Belegpflicht

- Jede fachliche Aussage ist zu belegen. Belege stammen ausschließlich aus dem
  Payload des Prompts; nichts darf aus anderem Wissen als Beleg ausgegeben werden.
- Verweis auf ein Spezifikationselement oder Requirement (nur IDs, die im
  Payload vorkommen):
  `<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_…">[SWS_…]</a>` — ohne `href`; den
  Link setzt der Generator.
- Verweis auf eine Dokumentstelle (nur Dokument/Seite aus dem Payload):
  `<span class="docref" data-doc="<Dokument-ID>" data-page="<Seite>">Kurzname §x.y „Titel“</span>`.
- Niemals URLs ausgeben, insbesondere keine PDF-URLs.

## Annahmen (Wissenslücken)

- Wo die Quellen schweigen, sind höchstens 3 Annahmen je Text und 2 je
  Diagramm erlaubt.
- Jede Annahme ist im Text als Interpretation erkennbar („dürfte“, „vermutlich“,
  „Interpretation:“) und wird am Ende des Fragments in einem Kommentar
  `<!-- annahmen: 1) … – Begründung: … -->` aufgezählt.
- Reicht das Budget nicht, wird der Aspekt weggelassen — niemals unmarkiert
  spekulieren.

## Diagramme

Ein Diagramm nur, wenn es gegenüber dem Text Mehrwert bietet:

- Sequenzdiagramm: Abläufe ab 3 Schritten oder mit nicht offensichtlicher
  Reihenfolge/Asynchronität.
- Kontext-/Kollaborationsdiagramm: ab 3 beteiligten Komponenten.
- Zustandsdiagramm: Lebenszyklen und Zustandsmaschinen.
- Aktivitätsdiagramm: Entscheidungs- oder Verarbeitungsabläufe mit Verzweigung.
- Keine Trivialdiagramme (einzelne Aufrufe, Getter/Setter, Zweierbeziehungen).

Beschriftungen deutsch, Bezeichner unverändert. Jedes Diagramm steht im
Fragment als Platzhalter `<div class="diagram" id="diag-<kurzname>"></div>`,
direkt gefolgt von `<p class="diagram-note"><Diagrammart>: <Kernaussage>.
Quellen: <Belege></p>`. Die Diagrammquelle wird separat ausgegeben (Format
legt der Prompt fest).

LEITBILD FÜR CLUSTER-LEITFÄDEN (AUTOSAR Classic Platform):
- 800–1500 Wörter in 4–7 thematischen Abschnitten mit <h4>-Überschriften:
  1. Systemarchitektur & Rolle des Modulclusters (Zweck, beteiligte BSW-Module und Standards wie ISO 14229, ISO 15765, AUTOSAR BSW-Schichten).
  2. Zusammenspiel & Interaktionspfade zwischen den Modulen (Nachrichten-/Datenfluss, Aufrufketten, Puffer-/Statusübergabe).
  3. Synchronisation, Reentranz und Task-Kontexte (MainFunctions, Interrupt-Kontext vs. Task-Ebene, Exklusive Bereiche).
  4. Typische Lebenszyklen und Betriebsmodi (Initialisierungsreihenfolge, Moduswechsel, Shutdown/Sleep/Wakeup).
  5. Fehlerbehandlung, Det-Tracing und Degradation (Fehlererkennung, DEM-Fehlerspeicher, Fallback-Strategien).
- Jeder Absatz enthält mindestens einen Beleg (Requirement-ID oder Dokumentstelle).
- 1–3 Diagramme: Sequenzdiagramm für modulinternes Zusammenspiel oder dot-Architekturdiagramm.
- Das Fragment beginnt mit <div class="ai cluster-guide"> und endet mit <p class="ai-note">…</p></div>.

AUSGABEFORMAT (verbindlich, nichts außerhalb dieser Blöcke):
<<<FRAGMENT
<div class="…"> … </div>
FRAGMENT>>>
Danach je Diagramm-Platzhalter genau ein Block:
<<<DIAGRAM diag-<kurzname> seq
<JSON nach dem Sequenz-Schema>
DIAGRAM>>>
oder
<<<DIAGRAM diag-<kurzname> dot
<Graphviz-digraph ohne Stilattribute (Farben/Schriften setzt der Generator)>
DIAGRAM>>>

Sequenz-Schema (JSON):
{"titel": str, "teilnehmer": [{"name": str}], "schritte": [
  {"art": "nachricht", "von": <idx>, "nach": <idx>, "text": [str], "pfeil": "voll"|"offen", "gestrichelt": bool},
  {"art": "selbst", "teilnehmer": <idx>, "text": [str]},
  {"art": "notiz", "ueber": [<idx>, <idx>], "text": [str]},
  {"art": "abschnitt", "text": str},
  {"art": "rahmen", "typ": "alt"|"opt"|"loop", "guard": str}, {"art": "trenner", "guard": str}, {"art": "rahmen-ende"}
]}
Antworten/Rückgaben: "pfeil": "offen", "gestrichelt": true. Zustands-, Kontext- und Aktivitätsdiagramme als dot.

   "id": "SWS_SecOC_00201",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "If SecOCTxSecuredPduCollection is used, then SecOC shall transmit the Secured I - PDU as two messages: The original Authentic I - PDU and a separate Cryptograph…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_00202",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "SecOC shall transmit an Authentic I - PDU and its corresponding Cryptographic I - PDU within the same main function cycle."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_00203",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "If SecOC R xSecuredPduCollection is used then SecOC shall not perform any verification until it has received both the Authentic I - PDU and Cryptographic I - PD…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_00204",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "SecOC shall provide separate buffers for the incoming Secured I - PDU, Cryptographic I - PDU and the resulting Authentic I - PDU."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_00206",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "SecOC shall construct and the Secured I - PDU immed iately after it has received both the respective Authentic I - PDU and Cryptographic I - PDU. If SecOC_Verif…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_00207",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "If the subsequent verification of the resulting Secured I - PDU is successful, then SecOC shall clear the buffers of both the Authentic and Cryptographic I - PD…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_00208",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "If SecOC has received both an Authentic I - PDU and a Cryptographic PDU and the verification of the resulting Secured I - PDU fails, both the Authentic and Cryp…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_00209",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "If SecOCTxSecuredPduCollection is used then SecOC shall repeat a part of the Authentic I - PDU inside the Cryptographic I - PDU as Message Linker and the Crypto…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_00210",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "If SecOCUseMessageLink is used then SecOC shall use the value at bit position SecOCMessageLinkPos of length SecOCMessageLinkLen bits inside the Authentic I - PD…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_00211",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "If SecOC R xSecuredPduCollection is used then SecOC shall not attempt to verify the Secured I - PDU until it has received and buffered an Authentic I - PDU and…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_00212",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "SecOC shall ensure that MetaData received in an authentic PDU will be present unchanged in the corresponding secured P DU, and vice versa ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_00229",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "If the authentication build counter has reached the configuration value SecOCAuthenticationBuildAttempts, or the query of the freshness function returns E_NOT_O…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_00230",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "If SecOCQueryFreshnessValue = CFUNC AND SecOCProvideTxTruncatedFreshnessValue = TRUE for a PDU configuration, SecOC calls a function named SecOC_GetTxFreshnessT…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_00231",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "If SecOCQueryFreshnessValue = CFUNC AND SecOCProvideTxTruncatedFreshnessValue = FALSE for a PDU configuration, Specification of Secure Onboard Communication AUT…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_00232",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "If SecOCQueryFreshnessValue = CFUNC for a PDU configuration, SecOC calls a function with the signature described in SWS_SecOC_91005 to indicate that the Secured…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_00233",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "If SecOCQueryFreshnessValue = RTE for a PDU configuration, SecOC calls the service operation FreshnessManagement_SPduTxConfirmation to indicate that the Secured…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_00234",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "For every proces sed secured I - PDU within SecOC an authentication build counter and an authentication verify attempt counter shall be maintained."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_00235",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "Upon the initial processing of a received secured I - PDU, the authentica tion build counter and the authentication verify attempt counter shall be set to 0."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_00236",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "If the query of the freshness function (e.g. SecOC_GetRxFreshness() ) returns E_BUSY the authentication build counter shall be incremented and no attempt for ve…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_00237",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "If the verification of the authenticator (e.g. Csm_MacVerify() ) returns E_BUSY , QUEUE_FULL or any other recoverable error, the authentication build counter sh…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_00238",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "If the authentication build attempts have failed and the authentication build counter has not yet reached the configuration value SecOCAuthenticationBuildAttemp…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_00239",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "If the verification of the authenticator could be successfully executed but the verification failed (e.g. the MAC verification has failed or the key was invalid…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_00240",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "If the authentication build counter has reached the configuration value SecOCAuthenticationBuildAttempts the SecOC module shall remove the Authentic I - PDU fro…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_00241",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "If the authentication verify attempt counter has reached the configuration value SecOCAuthenticationVerifyAttempts or the verification of the authenticator has…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_00242",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "If the verification of the authenticator was successful, the VerificationResultType shall be set to SECOC_VERIFICATIONSUCCESS ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_00243",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "The Freshn ess Management shall use the verification status cal lout function (SWS_SECOC_00119 ) to get the result of the verification of a secured I - PDU. Thi…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_00244",

   "text": "If SecOCQueryFreshnessValue = RTE AND SecOCUseAuthDataFreshness = TRUE for a PDU configuration and the secured PDU is received completely, the SecOC calls the R…"
  },
  {

   "text": "If SecOCQueryFreshnessValue = RTE AND SecOCUseAuthDataFreshness = FALSE for a PDU configuration and the secured PDU is received completely, the SecOC calls the…"
  },

   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "If SecOCQueryFreshnessValue = CFUNC AND SecOCUseAuthData Freshness = TRUE for a PDU configuration and the secured PDU is received completely, the SecOC calls th…"
  },
  {

   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "If SecOCQueryFreshnessValue = CFUNC AND SecOCUseAuthDataFreshness = FALSE for a PDU configuration and the secured PDU is received completely, the SecOC calls th…"
  },
  {

   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "If the Rx freshness request function returns E_NOT_OK, the verification of an Authentic I - PDU is considered to be failed and the authentication retry counter…"
  },
  {

  },

  },
  {

   "text": "Specification of Secure Onboard Communication AUTOSAR CP R20 - 11 47 of 179 Document ID 654 : AUTOSAR_SWS_SecureOnboardCommunication The SecOC module shall copy…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_00253",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "In case SecOCPduType is configured to SECOC_TPPDU , then function SecOC_TpTransmit shall trigger the transmit operation for an Authentic I - PDU."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_00254",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "After a transmit operation for SecOCPduType of SECOC_TPPDU was triggered, the SecOC shall instruct the upper layer to copy the next part of the I - PDU to a loc…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_00255",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "The SecOC module shall receive the complete Secured I - PDU in its internal memory before starting any copying of the corresponding Authentic I - PDU ."
  },
  {

   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "If the query of the freshness function returns E_NOT_OK the SecOC module shall remove the Authentic I - PDU from its internal buffer and shall drop the received…"
  },

  },

   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "For a Secu red Rx I - PDU with SecOCAuthPduHeaderLength = 0 or not configured and DynamicLength of the referred global Pdu (see ECUC_EcuC_00078) is set to TRUE,…"

   "text": "For a Secured Rx I - PDU with SecOCAuthPduHeaderLength > 0, the SecOC module shall extract the Authentic I - PDU using the length provided at runtime within the…"
  },

   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "If the upper layer transport protocol module reports BUFREQ_E_BUSY in a call to PduR_SecOCTpCopyTxData then SecOC shall retry the call in the next subsequent ca…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_00266",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "If the upper layer transport protocol module reports BUFREQ_E_NOT_OK in a call to PduR_SecOCTpCopyTxData then SecOC shall immediately abort the transmission via…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_00267",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "If the upper layer transport protocol module reports BUFREQ_E_NOT_OK in a call to PduR_SecOCTpCopyRxData then SecOC shall immediately abort the reception via ca…"
  },

   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "During reception of a static length (Secured / Authentic / Cryptographic) I - PDU, i.e. EcuC Parameter DynamicLength (ECUC_EcuC_00078) is set to FALSE, by means…"
  },

   "module": "SecOC",

  },

   "text": "Name Verification Status Indication Comment This service realizes a notification service that is used to propagate the status of an authentication attempt from…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_91020",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "Name Send Default Authentication Information Kind Provided Port Interface Send Default Authentication Information Description -- Variation ({ecuc(Sec OC/ Sec OC…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_91021",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "Name Verification Status Kind Provided Port Interface Verification Status Description -- Variation --"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_91022",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "Name Verify Status Configuration Kind Provided Port Interface Verify Status Configuration Description -- Specification of Secure Onboard Communication AUTOSAR C…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_SecOC_CONSTR_00265",
   "module": "SecOC",
   "text": "Within the same configured SecOCRxPduProcessing , if SecOCReceptionOverflowStrategy is set to QUEUE , then SecOCRxSecuredPduCollection shall have multiplicity o…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00101",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM module shall include the header file Det.h if the pa- rameter IdsMDevErrorDetect is enabled."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00102",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM module shall include the header file Dem.h if the pa- rameter IdsMSinkDem is enabled."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00103",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM module shall include the header file Dcm.h if the pa- rameter IdsMDiagnosticSupport is enabled."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00104",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM module shall include the header file NvM.h if the pa- rameter IdsMNvmBlockDescriptor is configured."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00105",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM module shall include the header file PduR.h if the parameter IdsMSinkIdsR is enabled."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00202",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "A call to IdsM_Init initializes all internal variables and sets the IdsM module to the initialized state."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00203",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "If development error reporting is enabled via IdsMDevEr- rorDetect , the IdsM module shall call Det_ReportError with the error code IDSM_E_PARAM_UNINIT when any…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00204",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "When IdsM_Init is called in initialized state, the IdsM mod- ule shall not re-initialize its internal variables. It shall instead call Det_ReportError with the…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00300",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM shall be able to receive SEv s with the service IdsM_- SetSecurityEvent when there no context data is reported."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00301",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM shall be able to receive SEv s with the service IdsM_- SetSecurityEventWithContextData when the optional context data is re- ported."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00401",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM shall be able to receive SEv s with a counter calculated from a smart sensor with the service IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithCount"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00402",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM shall be able to receive SEv s with a counter calculated from a smart sensor, and additionally the SEv context data, with the service IdsM_- SetSecurit…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00403",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM shall be able to receive SEv s with a timestamp and a counter calculated from a smart sensor with the service IdsM_SetSecurityEven- tWithTimestampCount"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00404",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM shall be able to receive SEv s with a timestamp, a counter calculated from a smart sensor,and additionally the SEv context data, with the service IdsM_…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00405",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "For reporting a SEv s with a timestamp but with no previously cal- culated counter, the services IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithTimestampCount- ContextData and IdsM_S…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00501",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The functions IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithContext- Data , IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithCountContextData and IdsM_SetSecu- rityEventWithTimestampCountContextData shall…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00502",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The functions calling IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithCon- textData , IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithCountContextData and IdsM_Set- SecurityEventWithTimestampCountContextDat…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00600",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM module shall represent each SEv instance by an IdsMExternalEventId , a IdsMSensorInstanceId , a IdsMInternalEventId , and the related EventName. These…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00601",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Each SEv shall have an IdsMInternalEventId . This param- eter shall not be configured manually. The IdsM shall calculate the value of this param- eter internall…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00602",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Sensors using the IdsM API to report SEv s shall not rely on the value of the parameter IdsMInternalEventId . Instead, they shall use the symbolic constant (Sym…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00603",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Each SEv shall have an external event ID IdsMExter- nalEventId , which is a global and unique ID per Security Event Type repre- sented by the ECU configuration,…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00604",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "A IdsMExternalEventId with value 0xFFFF shall be consid- ered invalid."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00605",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Each SEv shall have a sensor instance ID IdsMSensorIn- stanceId . This is the representation of the module number, in case there are many instances of the same…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00606",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The combination of external event ID IdsMExternalEventId and sensor instance ID IdsMSensorInstanceId shall make the SEv s uniquely iden- tifiable within the con…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00607",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Sensors using the IdsM services shall report a SEv using the symbolic constant (SymbolicNameValue) of the IdsMEvent Container ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00608",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Each SEv shall have a IdsMSensorInstanceId configured. In case there are several instances of the same sensor reporting SEv s with the same Event Definition ID…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00701",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM shall have a configurable number of event buffers IdsMNumberOfEventBuffers , depending on the amount of configured IdsMEvents that are to be handled."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00702",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Upon reception of a SEv , the IdsM shall store the event in an Event Buffer until it can be further processed. Event buffers shall be handled and filtered async…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00703",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "In case no Event Buffer is found. The IdsM inter- nal SEv 'No Event Buffer Available' shall be triggered, in case it has been configured."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00704",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM shall have a configurable number of context data buffers IdsMNumberOfContextDataBuffers with different configurable sizes IdsMContextDataBufferSize in…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00705",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Upon reception of a SEv with context data, the IdsM shall store the context data in an Context Data Buffer with the most adequate size available. A configured C…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00706",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Once an appropriate Context Data Buffer has been found, it shall be linked to the corresponding Event Buffer for further processing."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00707",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "In case there is no appropriate Context Data Buffer of the same size or larger than the context data, the event shall be processed as an event without context d…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00708",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "In case no appropriate Context Data Buffer is found. The IdsM internal SEv 'No Context Data Buffer Avail- able' shall be triggered, in case it has been configur…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00709",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Upon reception of a SEv with no context data, the IdsM shall not use any Context Data Buffer . Thus no context data buffer will be linked to the processed SEv ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00801",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The security events reported by IdsM module are listed in [SWS_IdsM_91015]."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00802",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "In case the IdsM Internal Events are configured, the IdsM shall provide own buffers for each one of these SEv s. These are dedicated buffers, inde- pendent from…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00803",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "IdsM internal SEv s shall not be filtered by IdsM instance spe- cific filters."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00804",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "IdsM internal SEv s can be filtered by IdsM SEvID specific fil- ters."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00901",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM shall store the SEv s in the Event Buffer s and pro- cess them asynchronously in the IdsM_MainFunction service in order to identify them as QSEv s."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00902",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The qualification of reported security events shall take place by evaluating the processed SEv against a configurable sequence of filters, known as the filter c…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00903",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "A SEv shall contain the information of the filter chain that is used to qualify it into a QSEv ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00904",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Each filter shall reject a processed SEv in case the filter criteria are not met by dropping it."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00905",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Otherwise, if a filter does not drop a SEv , the filter shall forward the currently processed SEv to the next filter in the chain."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00906",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "A filter shall be able to modify the SEv s counter according to their algorithm, if they are of type sampling or aggregation."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01001",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Filter chain selection When a SEv is reported, the IdsM shall apply the filter chain that is mapped to it."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01002",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Filter chain evaluation IdsM shall evaluate the filter chain after evaluating the reporting mode."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01003",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Possible Filters Each filter chain may consist of the following filters: • BlockState Filter • Forward Every nth Filter • Event Aggregation Filter • Event Thres…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01004",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Filter chain order IdsM shall evaluate all activated filter in the order BlockState Filter, Forward-Every-nth Filter, Event Aggregation Filter, Event Threshold…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01005",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Dropping of SEvs If the evaluation of one filter leads to dropping the SEv , IdsM shall not evaluate any additional filter."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01010",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM shall provide a reporting mode filter for each instance of SEv ID. This Filter is mandatory for each configured SEv ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01011",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The reporting mode filter shall not part of a filter chain. It shall be directly linked to the respective SEv ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01012",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Reporting Mode IdsM shall determine the default report- ing mode of each reported SEv from the IdsMReportingModeFilter ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01013",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Reporting Mode Options IdsM shall handle a reported SEv depending on its reporting mode according to Table Table 7.1."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01020",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM shall provide a block state filter. See IdsMBlock- StateFilter ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01021",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The block state filter shall represent a list of states in which the collection of the SEv s shall be blocked (the SEv s shall be dropped)."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01022",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM shall be inform, by the BswM module, about the current state with the callback service IdsM_BswM_StateChanged . This information shall be used when a b…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01023",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Block State Filter If IdsM evaluates the Block State Filter and the current block state equals one of the states referenced by IdsMBlockState , then IdsM shall…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01024",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The block state filter shall forward the SEv to the next filter in the chain if the current state is not part of the list. In case this is the last filter in th…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01030",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM shall provide Forward Every Nth filter."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01031",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Sampling Filter If IdsM evaluates the sampling filter for a SEv , IdsM shall drop all the SEv s but every nth , where n is defined in IdsMNthParam- eter . Forwa…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01032",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Sampling Filter Initialization IdsM shall initialize the sampling filter for a SEv so that the first received SEv is forwarded."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01033",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The forwarding of the SEv s by the Forward Every Nth filter shall be done without modification of SEv data."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01040",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM shall provide an aggregation filter."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01041",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Configuration of Event Aggregation Filter The parameter IdsMEventAggregationTimeInterval shall represent the duration of the interval during which SEv s of the…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01042",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The aggregation filter shall forward a SEv with the sum of the SEv 's counters processed in an interval. Considering the configuration for a specific SEv , of t…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01043",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "No Event Forwarding During Interval The aggregation filter shall not forward (i.e., to the next filter) any incoming SEv during the aggregation inter- val."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01044",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "End of Interval: No Event If no SEv of the same event type has been received by the aggregation filter in the past aggregation interval, no action shall be take…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01045",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "End of Interval: One or More Events If one or more SEv of the same event type have been received by the aggregation filter in the past aggregation interval, a S…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01046",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "End of Interval: Count If the SEv is forwarded to the next filter in the filter chain, the count parameter of the SEv shall equal the sum of all count parameter…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01047",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "End of Interval: First Context Data If the SEv is forwarded to the next filter in the filter chain and if IdsMContextDataSourceSelector equals IDSM_FILTERS_CTX_…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01048",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "End of Interval: Last Context Data If the SEv is forwarded to the next filter in the filter chain and if IdsMContextDataSourceSelector equals IDSM_FILTERS_CTX_U…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01049",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "End of Interval: Timestamp If the SEv is forwarded to the next filter in the filter chain, the timestamp shall be taken from the same SEv from which the context…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01050",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The time interval for each aggregation filter IdsMEventAggre- gationTimeInterval shall be a multiple of the main function period IdsMMain- FunctionPeriod ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01051",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The counting of the time interval for the aggregation filter IdsMEventAggregationTimeInterval shall start with the first call of the main function."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01060",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM shall provide a threshold filter."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01061",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Event Dropping Below Threshold The threshold filter shall drop an SEv of given type if the sum of count parameters of all SEv s of given type that were processe…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01062",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Event Forwarding Above Threshold The threshold filter shall forward an SEv of given type if the sum of count parameters of all SEv s of given type that were pro…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01063",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The counter of the events shall reset every time the threshold interval expires."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01064",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The configured time interval for each threshold filter IdsMEventThresholdTimeInterval shall be a multiple of the IdsMMainFunc- tionPeriod ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01065",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The counting of the time interval for the threshold filter IdsMEventThresholdTimeInterval shall start with the first call of the main func- tion."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01070",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Rate and Traffic Limitation Before sending a QSEv to the IdsR , IdsM shall apply rate and traffic limitation that can lead to dropping the QSEv from transmissio…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01080",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM shall provide a rate limitation filter. This filter speci- fies a limit in number of SEv s and an interval in milliseconds."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01081",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Rate Limitation IdsM shall drop an QSEv from transmission, if its transmission would cause the number of QSEv s transmitted in the current interval ( specified…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01082",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The time interval for the event rate limitation filter IdsMRate- LimitationTimeInterval shall be a multiple of the main function period IdsM- MainFunctionPeriod…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01090",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM shall provide a traffic limitation filter. This filter spec- ifies a limit in bytes and an interval in milliseconds."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01091",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Traffic Limitation IdsM shall drop an QSEv from transmission, if its transmission would cause the number of bytes transmitted in the current in- terval (specifi…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01092",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The time interval for the traffic limitation filter IdsMTraffi- cLimitationTimeInterval shall be a multiple of the main function period IdsM- MainFunctionPeriod…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01093",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM shall reset the byte counter to 0 when the interval IdsMTrafficLimitationTimeInterval expires."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01094",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "In case the number of bytes trying to be sent dur- ing a time period exceeds the maximum number of transmitted bytes IdsMTrafficLimitationMaximumBytes , The Ids…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01100",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM shall be able to add an additional IDS Message Timestamp field to the QSEv . The timestamp feature is optional and shall be acti- vated and configured…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01101",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "In case the SEv s do not contain the optional information of a timestamp (the sensor does not include it when it reports a SEv to the IdsM), the IdsM shall requ…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01103",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The option None in IdsMTimestampOption shall disable the timestamp feature."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01104",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The option AUTOSAR in IdsMTimestampOption shall en- able the timestamp feature and determines that the source of the timestamp is the AUTOSAR StbM module by cal…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01105",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The option Custom in IdsMTimestampOption shall enable the timestamp feature and determines that the source of the timestamp is provided by the application softw…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01106",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Timestamps are optional If the parameter IdsMTimestam- pOption is equals None , the IdsM shall not add a timestamp to a QSEv . The IdsM shall ignore timestamps…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01107",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Timestamps provided by the stack If IdsMTimestampOp- tion is set to \"`AUTOSAR\"' and the SEv is reported without a timestamp parameter, 33 of 104 Document ID 977…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01108",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Timestamp provided via event reporting interface If the timestamp feature is enabled and the SEv is reported with a timestamp parameter via the services IdsM_Se…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01109",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Timestamp provided via application software If IdsMTimes- tampOption is set to \"`Custom\"', and the SEv is reported without a timestamp param- eter, then IdsM sh…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01110",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Truncation of timestamp parameter If the SEv is reported with a timestamp parameter, then IdsM shall truncate this value by the 2 most-significant bits, i.e., o…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01111",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "If the option Custom in IdsMTimestampOption is enabled, the IdsM shall use the Client Server Interface IdsM_CustomTimestamp with the op- eration Get , which the…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01112",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Timestamp not provided via event reporting interface If the timestamp feature is enabled and the SEv is reported without a timestamp parameter via the services…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01200",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The QSEv s shall have a defined structure independent of the sink it is being sent to. The components of a QSEv are listed in table Table 7.2. For further detai…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01201",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The configuration of a SEv IdsMEvent shall contain a list of data sinks which are used for the resulting QSEv ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01202",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM shall provide the functionality for forwarding qualified on-board security events QSEv s to other ECUs via the PduR module."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01203",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "QSEv transmission The IdsM shall be able to use the sink IdsR for the configured events. The IdsMSinkIdsR indicates that the corresponding QSEv shall be sent vi…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01204",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Signing QSEv The IdsM shall be able to attach a cryptographic signature, with the same data format, to each QSEv . The signature feature is optional and shall b…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01205",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM's Csm Job IdsMSignatureGenerateRe- sultLength shall define the length in bytes of the signature calculated by the crypto services. It shall be configur…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01206",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "In order to generate a signature by a Csm job IdsMCsmJobRef- erence , the signature generation shall be triggered by calling the Csm function Csm_- SignatureGen…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01207",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "If the signature is generated by a synchronous Csm job IdsMC- smJobReference , when the function Csm_SignatureGenerate returns, the signa- ture shall be immedia…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01208",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "If the signature is generated by an asynchronous Csm job IdsM- CsmJobReference , the IdsM shall be informed about the generation of the signature by Csm via the…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01300",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "A SEv s reported by a SW-C shall define a maximum number of bytes for the transmission of the context data. IdsMEventMaxContextDataSize ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01301",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "No additional Interface Option The SW-C Service Port Inter- face shall not provide additional information other than the optional context data when the option N…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01302",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Additional Interface Option: Count The SW-C Service Port In- terface shall be extended by the parameter count when the option Count is configured in IdsMAdditio…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01303",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Additional Interface Option: Count and timestamp The SW-C Service Port Interface shall be extended by the parameters count and timestamp when the option CountTi…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01400",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM shall send its data via a interface PDU ( IF - PDU ) if the complete IDS Message with its additional IDS Message Signature , if available, fits in a si…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01401",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Otherwise, if the data does not fit in a single IF - PDU frame, it shall be send via transport protocol using TP - PDU s. Configured in: IdsMTpTxPdu ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01498",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "After the IdsM has processed the SEv s, the resulting QSEv s which have passed the filtering and have the IdsMSinkIdsR configured, shall be transmitted using th…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01499",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "IdsM shall not call PduR_IdsMTransmit again before IdsM_- TpTxConfirmation or IdsM_TxConfirmation have been called."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01500",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM shall receive the confirmation for the complete trans- mission of the IF upper layer Tx-Pdu by the PduR Module with the service IdsM_Tx- Confirmation ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01501",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM shall be able to transmit segmented PDU s with the service IdsM_CopyTxData . The function shall be called several times, each call to this function sha…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01502",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM shall receive the confirmation of the transmission of a segmented PDU by the PduR Module with the service IdsM_TpTxConfirmation ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01600",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "⌊ DRAFT g The IdsM shall provide a functionality for persisting on-board QSEv s, with their corresponding optional fields: context data and timestamp in Dem / S…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01601",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "⌊ DRAFT g The IdsM shall be able to use the sink Dem / Sem for the configured events. The Sem sink indicates that the corresponding QSEv shall be stored in the…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01602",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "⌊ DRAFT g The data stored in Dem / Sem is the complete IDS Mes- sage with its mandatory and optional fields."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01700",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM shall be able to persist the parameter \"Reporting Mode\" of a SEv in the NvM."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01701",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The write routine of the NvM block NvM_WriteBlock shall be triggered after the modification of a \"Reporting Mode\" value IdsMReportingMode- Filter has been succe…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01702",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "If the persistence in the NvM block fails, the IdsM shall roll back the SEv 's \"Reporting Mode\" IdsMReportingModeFilter , to the value before the diagnostic mod…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01703",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The IdsM shall be able to read out the \"Reporting Mode\" IdsM- ReportingModeFilter persisted in the NvM for the corresponding SEv s handled by the IdsM instance."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01704",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "In case there are no NvM values available for the \"Reporting Mode\" IdsMReportingModeFilter of the SEv s, the configured values provided in the configuration too…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01705",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The NvM block descriptor referenced by IdsMNvmBlockDe- scriptor , shall be a block processed during NvM_ReadAll ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01706",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The supported NvM RAM block name shall be IdsM_NvMRamBlockData."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01707",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The supported NvM ROM block name shall be IdsM_NvMRomBlockData."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01800",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The diagnostic handling feature shall be optional. It shall be activated or deactivated with the parameter IdsMDiagnosticSupport ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01900",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The \"Reporting Mode\" IdsMReportingModeFilter of a SEv shall be modifiable during run-time via the diagnostic services of the Dcm ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01901",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The service IdsM_Dcm_SetReportingMode_Start called by the Dcm module shall enable the IdsM to modify the reporting mode IdsMReport- ingModeFilter of a specific…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01902",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "In case the reporting mode parameter in IdsM_- Dcm_SetReportingMode_Start is invalid, this IdsM service shall return DCM_E_REQUESTOUTOFRANGE as its Dcm negative…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01903",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "In case the Security Event Definition Id used for the call IdsM_Dcm_SetReportingMode_Start is invalid, this IdsM service shall return DCM_E_REQUESTOUTOFRANGE as…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01904",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "In case the request to NvM to persist the new reporting mode fails, this IdsM service shall return DCM_E_GENERALPROGRAMMINGFAILURE as its Dcm negative response…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01905",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "In case the request to NvM to persist the new reporting mode fails, this IdsM service shall roll back to the previously configured reporting mode."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_02000",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The \"Reporting Mode\" IdsMReportingModeFilter of a SEv shall be readable via the diagnostic services of the Dcm."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_02001",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The service IdsM_Dcm_GetReportingMode_Start called by the Dcm module shall trigger the IdsM 's routine execution to request the current report- ing mode of a sp…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_02002",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "The service IdsM_Dcm_GetReportingMode_RequestRe- sults called by the Dcm module shall allow the IdsM to provide the routine results and reporting mode for the r…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_02003",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "Type of error Related error code Error value API function called with an invalid event identifier. IDSM_E_PARAM_INVALID 0x0A API function called with a NULL poi…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_02101",
   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "With development error detection IdsMDevErrorDetect en- abled, the IdsM module shall check the parameter securityEventId of the function IdsM_SetSecurityEvent a…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_02102",

  },

   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "With development error detection IdsMDevErrorDetect en- abled, the IdsM module shall check the parameters securityEventId and count of the function IdsM_SetSecu…"
  },
  {

   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "With development error detection IdsMDevErrorDetect en- abled, the IdsM module shall check the parameter contextDataSize of the function 42 of 104 Document ID 9…"
  },

   "module": "IdsM",
   "text": "With development error detection IdsMDevErrorDetect en- abled, the IdsM module shall check the parameter contextDataSize of the function IdsM_SetSecurityEventWi…"

   "text": "If the Crypto Driver is not yet initialized and if development error detection for the Crypto Driver is enabled, the function Crypto_KeyElementCopyPartial shall…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_Crypto_00207",

  },

  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_Crypto_00209",
   "module": "Crypto",
   "text": "If no errors are detected by the Crypto Driver, the function Crypto_KeyElementCopyPartial shall copy a part of the key element referenced by keyElementId of t h…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_Crypto_00210",
   "module": "Crypto",
   "text": "If th e current length of the target key element is greater or equal than ( keyElementTargetOffset + keyElementCopyLength ), the key element length remains unch…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_Crypto_00211",
   "module": "Crypto",
   "text": "If the current length of the target key element is lower than ( keyEleme ntTargetOffset + keyElementCopyLength ) and the maximum length of the key element is gr…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_Crypto_00214",

   "text": "If n o errors are detected by Crypto Driver and the driver does currently not process this job, the service Crypto_CancelJob() shall return E_OK without any pro…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_Crypto_00215",
   "module": "Crypto",
   "text": "The Configuration point er configPtr shall always have a null pointer value ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_Crypto_00217",
   "module": "Crypto",
   "text": "The crypto Driver shall check if job - >cryptoKeyId and, if applicable, job - >targetCryptoKeyId are in range, before it executes a job. If the check fails, the…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_Crypto_00219",
   "module": "Crypto",
   "text": "Access rights shall be taken into account when direct access to key elements are required. This applies for read and write access."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_Crypto_00220",
   "module": "Crypto",
   "text": "A source key element must have higher or the same rights than the destination key element when key elements are copied using the key copying interfaces. A sourc…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_Crypto_00221",
   "module": "Crypto",
   "text": "Jobs shall use the assigned key elements without guarding the key access rights with the following exceptions:  If a key element is used for input using the in…"
  },

  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_Crypto_00223",

  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_Crypto_00224",
   "module": "Crypto",
   "text": "If a Crypto Driver requires Random Number Generator services for internal use (e.g. Crypto_KeyExchangeCalcPubVal), it shall configure the first Crypto Driver Ob…"
  },

  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_Crypto_00226",

<h4>Systemarchitektur &amp; Rolle des Modulclusters</h4>
<p>Das Modulcluster <em>Security &amp; Intrusion Detection</em> der AUTOSAR Classic Platform (Release R20-11) stellt die Basissicherheitsdienste für Steuergeräte bereit. Es setzt sich aus sechs zentralen Basissoftware-Modulen (BSW) zusammen: <code>SecOC</code> (Secure Onboard Communication), <code>IdsM</code> (Intrusion Detection System Manager), <code>KeyM</code> (Key Manager), <code>Csm</code> (Crypto Service Manager), <code>CryIf</code> (Crypto Interface) und <code>Crypto</code> (Crypto Driver). Gemeinsam gewährleisten diese Module den Schutz vor Manipulation und Ausspähung der fahrzeuginternen PDU-Kommunikation, die Erkennung und Filterung von Angriffsmustern sowie das sichere Schlüsselmanagement und die Abstraktion kryptografischer Hardwarebeschleuniger oder Software-Krypto-Bibliotheken <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_SecOC_00040" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_SecOC_00040">[SWS_SecOC_00040]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01202" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01202">[SWS_IdsM_01202]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_KeyM_00021" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_KeyM_00021">[SWS_KeyM_00021]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Csm_00940" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Csm_00940">[SWS_Csm_00940]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CryIf_91003" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CryIf_91003">[SWS_CryIf_91003]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Crypto_91003" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Crypto_91003">[SWS_Crypto_91003]</a>.</p>
<p>In der AUTOSAR-Schichtenarchitektur sind die Aufgaben klar aufgeteilt: <code>SecOC</code> fungiert als Kommunikationserweiterung unmittelbar auf PDU-Ebene neben dem PDU-Router (PduR) und sichert die Authentizität und Aktualität von I-PDUs über Message Authentication Codes (MAC) und Frischewerte ab <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_SecOC_00103" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_SecOC_00103">[SWS_SecOC_00103]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_SecOC_00138" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_SecOC_00138">[SWS_SecOC_00138]</a>. <code>IdsM</code> sammelt Sicherheitsereignisse (Security Events, SEvs) von BSW-Modulen und Applikations-SW-Cs, qualifiziert diese über strukturierte Filterketten zu QSEvs und übergibt sie an konfigurierte Senken wie PduR oder Dem <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00101" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00101">[SWS_IdsM_00101]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00902" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00902">[SWS_IdsM_00902]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01203" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01203">[SWS_IdsM_01203]</a>. <code>KeyM</code> verwaltet kryptografische Schlüssel und Zertifikatsketten (z.&nbsp;B. X.509) und steuert deren Aktualisierung und Verifikation <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_KeyM_00037" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_KeyM_00037">[SWS_KeyM_00037]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_KeyM_00059" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_KeyM_00059">[SWS_KeyM_00059]</a>. Der kryptografische Unterbau wird über den dreistufigen Krypto-Stack gebildet: <code>Csm</code> bietet standardisierte kryptografische Primitiven und Job-Warteschlangen für die BSW und Applikationsebene an <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Csm_00940" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Csm_00940">[SWS_Csm_00940]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Csm_01011" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Csm_01011">[SWS_Csm_01011]</a>; <code>CryIf</code> routet diese kanalisiert und treiberneutral an die jeweils zuständigen Treiberinstanzen weiter <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CryIf_00143" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CryIf_00143">[SWS_CryIf_00143]</a>; <code>Crypto</code> steuert schließlich Hardware-Security-Module (HSM) oder hardwarenahe Softwaretreiber partitioniert an <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Crypto_CONSTR_00001" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Crypto_CONSTR_00001">[SWS_Crypto_CONSTR_00001]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Crypto_CONSTR_00003" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Crypto_CONSTR_00003">[SWS_Crypto_CONSTR_00003]</a>.</p>
